description: This file defines classes and functions for managing browser targets, contexts, downloads, and related events in Firefox, specifically for integration with Playwright. It includes classes like TargetRegistry, PageTarget, BrowserContext, and DownloadInterceptor, and handles browser automation features such as download interception, page creation, context management, and screencast recording.

classes.name: DownloadInterceptor
classes.description: Handles download request interception, creation, completion, and cancellation in Firefox.

classes.name: TargetRegistry
classes.description: Manages browser targets, contexts, and events, facilitating page creation, context management, and download handling.

classes.name: PageTarget
classes.description: Represents a browser page, managing navigation, dialogs, viewport, recording, and other page-specific features.

classes.name: BrowserContext
classes.description: Represents a browser context, managing permissions, cookies, proxies, and page instances.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: Represents a modal dialog (alert, prompt, confirm) in a page.

methods.name: TargetRegistry.instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TargetRegistry.

methods.name: TargetRegistry.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TargetRegistry, sets up observers, window listeners, and download interception.

methods.name: TargetRegistry.cancelDownload
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download by UUID.

methods.name: TargetRegistry.newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page within a specified browser context.

methods.name: PageTarget.updateViewportSize
methods.description: Updates the page's viewport size and resizes the window accordingly.
